standard-dialogue-before-completing-sins.npc: You're not wrong about that. It's my travelling companion, Hanchen. They say he's the latest victim of the Sleeper Plague.

steps.npc: Some mysterious illness. You'll have to ask the sisters if you want to know more.
No, not at all. We came here from afar with the tattooed guy outside.
We travelled eastwards over many oceans.
I ask myself the same question. We came here on a quest. You see, I found a poem in the College of Bards that told of the sanctuary below. It seemed worthy of exploration.

steps.player: College of Bards? Can't say I've heard of it.

steps.npc: No? Have you not visited the grand Kingdom of Varlamore? The college is but one of many attractions.

steps.player: Oh really? Perhaps I should go there sometime.

steps.npc: You won't regret it! With all that's happened, I'd much rather be back there.

options.text: Tell me more about the sanctuary.

steps.player: Tell me more about the sanctuary.

steps.npc: To be honest, the poem didn't say much. Although I found this while searching this church.

steps.text: The jester hands you an old piece of parchment.

steps.player: Interesting, I'll give it a read!

standard-dialogue-after-completing-sins-.npc: Well it's not like I have much to be happy about. First one of my travelling companions catches the Sleeper Plague, then the other goes and gets executed. We should never have come here.
